title: Wiener · Where the capacity goes
description: Asked against used, worst case kept. A bare peak_rss means nothing without what was requested — over-allocation is the commonest waste in bioinformatics.

targets.rawSql:
SELECT SpanName AS process,
       formatReadableSize(max(toUInt64OrZero(SpanAttributes['wiener.task.memory_asked_bytes']))) AS asked,
       formatReadableSize(max(toUInt64OrZero(SpanAttributes['wiener.task.memory_peak_bytes']))) AS peak,
       round(100 * max(toUInt64OrZero(SpanAttributes['wiener.task.memory_peak_bytes']))
                 / max(toUInt64OrZero(SpanAttributes['wiener.task.memory_asked_bytes'])), 1) AS "% of ceiling"
FROM otel.otel_traces WHERE ParentSpanId != '' AND $__timeFilter(Timestamp)
GROUP BY process
HAVING max(toUInt64OrZero(SpanAttributes['wiener.task.memory_asked_bytes'])) > 0
ORDER BY "% of ceiling" DESC

defaults.noValue: No run reported memory. A pipeline built before resource labels asks for nothing, and a run launched without trace.enabled reports nothing.

panels.title: CPU — cores asked against cores used

targets.rawSql:
SELECT SpanName AS process,
       max(toUInt64OrZero(SpanAttributes['wiener.task.cpus_asked'])) AS "cores asked",
       round(max(toFloat64OrZero(SpanAttributes['wiener.task.cpu_used_pct'])) / 100, 1) AS "cores used"
FROM otel.otel_traces WHERE ParentSpanId != '' AND $__timeFilter(Timestamp)
GROUP BY process ORDER BY "cores asked" DESC

defaults.noValue: No run reported CPU. Launch with trace.enabled — Wiener's site.config does.

targets.rawSql:
SELECT SpanName AS process,
       formatReadableSize(sum(toUInt64OrZero(SpanAttributes['wiener.task.read_bytes']))) AS read,
       formatReadableSize(sum(toUInt64OrZero(SpanAttributes['wiener.task.write_bytes']))) AS written
FROM otel.otel_traces WHERE ParentSpanId != '' AND $__timeFilter(Timestamp)
GROUP BY process ORDER BY sum(toUInt64OrZero(SpanAttributes['wiener.task.read_bytes'])) DESC
